overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed that gpt-5.5 with function tools and no explicit reasoning_effort would be automatically bridged to the Responses API, but the actual product change (measured live 2026-10-02) makes gpt-5.4 and gpt-5.5 default to "none" reasoning and serve tools on Chat Completions without bridging. The unset-effort bridge was incorrectly kept active for gpt-5.5, causing the proxy to attempt routing to Responses where the 400 error is triggered.
why_it_breaks: The agent's edit replaced the old comment that said "only an explicit \"none\" keeps the request chat-servable" with a new comment stating that gpt-5.4/5.5 default to "none" and serve tools on Chat Completions, and unset effort bridges only from gpt-5.6. However, the code logic downstream of this comment (not shown in the diff) likely still attempts to unset reasoning_effort and bridge to Responses for gpt-5.5 when function tools are present. Since OpenAI's gpt-5.5 rejects function tools with any explicit reasoning_effort in Chat Completions (returning HTTP 400), the proxy's attempt to unset or bridge the effort triggers that error. The agent overlooked that the product change means gpt-5.5 should stay on Chat Completions without any bridging attempt when reasoning_effort is unset or "none".
